verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents Teams Export APIs for 1:1, group, meeting, and channel messages, which gives some data portability, but this is an admin/compliance-oriented API (not a simple self-service 'export and leave' flow) with no stated open-format guarantee and no mention of exporting files, calendars, or other associated data. Missing for 10: user-initiated self-service full-account export, explicit open/standard format specification (e.g. JSON schema, CSV), coverage of files/SharePoint-backed content and other data types, and any confirmation that a user can fully leave with all their data.
